Peak detailing by Aditya Dhar in Dhurandhar 2😂
Let’s uncover one of the most dangerous chemicals ever known in the history of Mankind—dimethylmercury. 
I’m taking you through the first shocking case that changed the face of toxicology forever. As an engineering student, reading medical literature gives me an adrenaline rush like no other and reading this Medical  case in my childhood has given me trauma like no other.😱
Dimethylmercury also plays an important role in the movie “Dhurandhar 2.” Medical mysteries —this is science at its most gripping! 

#science #medical #dhurandhar2 #instagramreels #literature
@tasmiatahsinnur we were talking about this yesterday!
Maine bhi 2 saal pehle is case k bare m padha tha
That's why I fear mercury thermometer so much 😭
Medical cases me still sabse darawana case wo brain. Surgery wala hai ( johny Depp ki movie me dikhaya bhi tha)  and 2nd wo stomach acid wala, 3rd europe ke wo home abortion procedure.
Bhai aap to keherehe the apne Dhurandhar 1,2 na dekhkar 7 hour ki savings ki thi 😂😂😂😂
Eak bar me curiosity me ubalti hui chai ka temperature check kar rah ta mercury thermometer se aur achanak se vo tu gaya aur uske aage...... 😭🙏
